description:
KFT 0.7.0's two counts, and the honest statement of what still blocks promotion after both are clean.

THE TWO GATES, per docs/reference/promotability.md. (i) The standing one: owner re-ratification of the strictly-additive FT-M…FT-Q producer-exhaust intake fold, which 'walks clean as written but has not been executed'; its stale-plane-pin precondition is closed by chief/71 and `kcs:producer-exhaust-finetune` exists, so the conformance gate is met for this gate. (ii) Added by 0.6.0: a re-run of the resume-checkpoint leg against the folded text.

WHY (ii) IS MORE READING THAN IT LOOKS. Unlike 0.5.0, 0.6.0 MOVES §4's admission inputs — where a job carries `resume`, `resume.checkpoint` joins §4.2's aggregate and §4.3's union — so §3.4/§4.2/§4.3/§5.4/§6/§7 are changed normative surface rather than re-validated text. The ladder: 'the owner reads six sections cold rather than re-reading walked ones.' A cold job admits exactly as before, which is why (i) is unaffected by (ii).

CORRECTED 2026-09-02 — THE ENCODING BLOCKER IS GONE, AND KOINE NEVER LEARNED. This tasklist was authored saying KFT 'cannot be promoted even on a clean re-run' because the tenth scenario had no KCS encoding (kcs-encoding-gate-verification.md §6.1, DR-11). That is FALSE and has been for a week. agora `378fd3c` — 'encode koine's three unencoded pressure tests — the console count gate is closed' — landed 2026-08-26 12:30, FORTY-NINE MINUTES after koine's gate doc was last updated at 11:41 recording them as unowned. Verified 2026-09-02: `console/src/kcs/scenarios/resume-checkpoint.ts` exists, is registered in `index.ts` against `scenarios/kft-resume-checkpoint.md`, and `coverage.test.ts` asserts `KOINE_SCENARIOS.length === 12` and passes. So KFT's artefact gate IS met and the promotion turns on the two prose re-runs alone. US-3 now verifies that rather than repeating the stale claim.

ALSO CARRIED HERE: 0.7.0's two audio modality tokens (text-to-audio / audio-to-audio, folded by chief/88 on 2026-08-27) are recorded as UNEXERCISED VOCABULARY that no pass has walked — not as a third gate. AUD-6 notes no scenario walks an audio job. This tasklist states the cross-repo obligation; it does not perform the consumer-side work in agora or lugh.

userStories.title: Gate (i) — the additive intake fold is executed, not just read as clean
acceptanceCriteria: The FT-M…FT-Q producer-exhaust intake fold is walked and its verdict recorded. The ladder says it 'walks clean as written but has not been executed' — executing it is this story, and a record that repeats 'walks clean' without a run does not discharge it.

userStories.title: Gate (ii) — six sections read cold against the resume-checkpoint leg
acceptanceCriteria: §3.4, §4.2, §4.3, §5.4, §6 and §7 are each read against the 0.6.0 folded text with `resume`-carrying jobs, and each gets its own verdict. These are CHANGED normative surface, not re-validated text — 0.6.0 moved §4's admission inputs.
The cold-job path is confirmed unchanged, which is what keeps gate (i) independent of this one. If it moved, say so — that would invalidate US-1's premise.

userStories.title: The encoding claim is re-checked, and KFT promotes if the re-runs are clean
acceptanceCriteria: Re-verify the artefact gate against agora AT A NAMED SHA before relying on either answer. As of 2026-09-02 `resume-checkpoint.ts` is registered and `coverage.test.ts` asserts 12 scenarios green — but this criterion exists because koine's own record was a week stale, so confirm rather than inherit.
IF the two re-runs are clean AND the artefact gate is met: KFT is promotable, and the record says so. The previous blocker — 'no runnable document citing 0.6.0's clauses' — no longer holds.

`docs/reference/kcs-encoding-gate-verification.md` §6.1 and `docs/reference/promotability.md` are corrected: DR-11 is CLOSED, closed downstream on 2026-08-26, and koine did not notice for a week. Record it as a dated correction, the way the argos and KGP corrections were, rather than editing the old text into looking right.

The 0.7.0 audio tokens are recorded as unexercised vocabulary with AUD-1…AUD-6's per-repo actions named and their owners identified. koine reports; agora and lugh act. Do not edit either repo from here.
